data.title: Dunning notice from Stadtwerke Beispielsoest for unpaid electricity and water advance payments
data.summary: Stadtwerke Beispielsoest GmbH sent a dunning notice (Mahnung) dated 19 November 2026 stating that the electricity and water advance payments (Abschläge) for October and November 2026, plus a €2.00 dunning fee, remain unpaid. The total of €226.00 is demanded by 10 December 2026, or the supply may be interrupted after prior notice.
data.explanation: Your utility provider says two monthly advance payments (Abschläge) for electricity and water were not received, and a small dunning fee was added. You need to pay the total of €226.00 by the stated deadline to avoid further action. If the supply is interrupted, the provider says it will give prior notice first, but it's best to pay promptly or contact them if you believe this is a mistake (e.g. if you already paid). Check your bank statements and the contract account number shown to confirm. No legal remedy instructions were included in this letter.
